verdict.rationale: Thoropass is a compliance SaaS platform, so bulk operations are a fair question. The evidence pack never documents a bulk-edit, multi-select, or batch action capability. Unified/shared controls and cross-workspace user management reduce duplicate work, and the MCP tools act on evidence requests one at a time, but these are adjacent features rather than bulk operations across many items.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
